account_custom_field_help.rewrite_hostname: Jinja template that builds the hostname of an imported object, with HOSTNAME as the name Netbox delivers and the object's attributes available. Example: {{ HOSTNAME }}.example.com
account_custom_field_help.import_filter: Limits the import to matching objects, as key:value pairs the Netbox API understands, comma separated. The same key given more than once is an OR, e.g. role:router,role:firewall.
account_custom_field_help.delete_host_if_not_found_on_import: Delete hosts of this account which the import no longer delivers. The value is a Mongoengine filter fieldname:value limiting which hosts may be deleted; combine several with ||.
